levels.surface: نافع بن محمود بن الربيع الأنصاري

notes: «قال نافع أبطأ عبادة» — the same man as the link before, written twice in succession: one link (rule 7).
«قلت لعبادة سمعتك ... قال أجل» — Ubada is asked and answers, and he relays the Prophet's words: the last link (rule 6). Abu Nu'aym and the prayer are scene only.
